notes.title: 🎉 HIBE Studio – Update Notes 🎉
notes.notes:
[u][b]✨ What’s New?  [/b][/u]
[b]🎭 Live2D & VRoid Support[/b]
- Import your Live2D Avatars directly into HIBE Studio!  
- VRoid Hub Login – Easily access your VRoid Avatars with a click.  
- VRoid Avatars now support Avatar Effects & 3D Animations!  

[u][b]🎥 Live Section Upgrades[/b][/u]
- Better expressions, animations, and tracking for all avatar types!  

🚀 Other Enhancements
✅ New Live Layout – Cleaner & easier to use!  
✅ Audio Input for Lip Sync – More natural expressions!  
✅ Performance Boost – Faster & smoother experience!  
✅ Onboarding Fixes – Improved camera calibration!  

🔥 Coming Soon  
⏳ System-wide Hotkeys – Arriving next week for quick & easy control!  
🔗 Twitch & TikTok Login + Trigger System for Live Events.  
🎮 Multi-Player Streaming & Game Rooms – Stream together effortlessly!  

💬 Try it out & let us know what you think! 🚀✨

notes.title: Updates Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Hibers! :sparkles:
Our new HIBE Studio Desktop 31.0.0 is now live on Steam!

Here’s what’s new and improved:
[olist]
[*] Super Emotes Props Category: Trigger fun text animations with our new Props category in the Super Emotes Section.
[*] My Super Emotes Category: Access all your emotes in one place in 'My Super Emotes'
[*] :Save Button UI for Super Emotes: Easily save your work with the 'CTA: Save' at the top-right corner.
[/olist]

:new: New Assets:
Introducing 'Turtleneck skin' and more avatar customization assets!

:spanner: Fixes & Improvements:
General UI Fixes: Improved overall interface for smoother navigation.
Eye Color Issue: Resolved the issue where eye colour will not change in Super Emotes.
Avatar Lock: Avatars will no longer move once locked, during live sessions.
Sway Animation Fix: Corrected sway animation bugs during head movement.

:pinata:User Guides: Handy tips for streaming, avatar setup, and more for the first-time user

:point_right: Update now on Steam & explore these features: bit.ly/hibe_studio

Feedback/Issues? Please Share with us anytime & drop them in 'feedback-queries' channel.
If you need further guidance, we are all ears!
